name: Pure Squeeze
notes: 3 photos: photo 1 is the primary printed juice-bar menu (juices at $8.95 base, plus ginger shots/specialty beverages/cleanse packs). Photo 3 is a handwritten 'Cold-Pressed Menu $9.95' chalkboard listing overlapping juices at a higher base price plus 3 juices not on photo 1 (Raspberry Blood, Blue Orchard, Summer Splash). Photo 2 is mostly an add-on chalkboard (chia seeds/collagen/pea protein, skipped as modifiers) but its top edge shows another board listing Green Goddess and Orange Creamsicle, which were included. Merged; kept photo 1's price for items appearing on both boards and used the chalkboard prices for chalkboard-only juices. The 5-day juice cleanse pack (a bundle of already-listed juices) was omitted.
